Author: Aeon Ortha
Name: SizeChange - Delta Suite
Description:
Configurable character growth from damage, accumulated growth pulses, aetheryte proximity and size drain. Includes separate Self, Added Players and Monsters settings, with Customize+ bone effects for Self and intercepted synced players.

Developed by Aeon Ortha. Credit to InsubstantialCoder for the initial idea and original SizeChange plugin: https://github.com/InsubstantialCoder

Use /sizechange to open settings.
Punchline: Configurable growth, damage accumulation and bone effects.
